reader_notes: Gap (5) has an echo trap: 'seam' is used earlier in the same paragraph ('a thin seam of high-value goods') and reappears as option B. The fixed idiom 'slip through the cracks' still makes C the only defensible reading, but the repetition invites a second look.
The setting is only 'the capital' — no country is named anywhere, while the platform name (Rundgång) and the reporter names read Swedish. Harmless, but the geography is left vague.
